title: QA-NCR-02 Non-Conformance Report Entry
summary: Ledgerline screen for creating, searching, fetching, and closing production and quality non-conformance reports.
body:
QA-NCR-02 is the Ledgerline screen used to log, view, search, and close non-conformance reports across receiving, production, and battery handling [^r5][^r12]. Accessible via `Production > Non-Conformance report`, it captures defect details and isolates non-conforming items such as rejected inspection lots or damaged battery packs [^r1][^r2][^r5]. Raising an NCR on this screen is required during the same shift an issue is detected to enforce timely containment [^r1][^r22][^r23].

| Field | Code | Menu path | Roles | Read services | Write services | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value | QA-NCR-02 | Production > Non-Conformance report | PRD-PLAN, PRD-SUP, QA-INSP, QA-MGR, SYS-ADMIN | ncr_get, ncr_search | ncr_save, ncr_close | current |

## Fields

Screen QA-NCR-02 contains the following header and detail fields [^r6]:
* **NCR NO** (`ncr_no`): Non-conformance report number (mandatory) [^r6][^r13].
* **ITEM CD** (`itm_cd`): Item identifier validated against the central master (mandatory) [^r6][^r7][^r13][^r20].
* **DEFECT CD** (`defect_cd`): Defect code describing the failure mode (mandatory) [^r6][^r13][^r20].
* **QTY** (`qty`): Defective quantity (mandatory) [^r6][^r13][^r20].
* **DESCRIPTION** (`descr`): Narrative detail of the defect (mandatory) [^r6][^r13][^r20].
* **GRN NO** (`grn_no`): Goods receipt note reference (optional) [^r6][^r13][^r20][^r21].
* **STATUS** (`status`): Processing status of the record (optional) [^r6][^r13][^r21].
* **COMMENT** (`comment`): Additional notes (optional) [^r6][^r13].

When logging incoming inspection failures under [[sop-qua-001|SOP-QUA-001]], the delivery reference, part identification, and specific failure reasons populate from the [[screen-qa-ins-01|QA-INS-01]] inspection sheet [^r2][^r3]. If a single consignment contains multiple defective item codes, an individual report must be created for each item reference rather than combining them [^r11].

Under [[pol-bat-004|POL-BAT-004]], [[sop-qua-002|SOP-QUA-002]], and BHT-01, team leaders must enter damaged, dropped, wet, or swollen [[items-bat|battery packs]] before the shift ends, uploading photographs of the damage, serial plate, and terminal condition [^r1][^r22][^r23]. Users must verify that the serial number in the header matches the casing label exactly and select defect classifications such as casing rupture, terminal shorting, or swelling [^r24]. If a casing serial number is defaced or illegible, the batch reference is entered on QA-NCR-02, the illegibility is noted in the narrative box, and a physical inspection is requested from the quality team [^r1][^r4].

## Keys and services

Screen QA-NCR-02 interacts with backend [[services-prd-ncr|PRD ncr services]] via four primary operations [^r5][^r14][^r15]:
* **ncr_search** (`F2` / `Enter`): Read service (`POST /ll72/svc/ncr_search`) that queries NCR records using optional filters `grn_no`, `itm_cd`, `defect_cd`, and `status` [^r14][^r21].
* **ncr_get** (`F3`): Read service (`POST /ll72/svc/ncr_get`) that retrieves an existing report record by `ncr_no` [^r14][^r17].
* **ncr_save** (`F8`): Write service (`POST /ll72/svc/ncr_save`) that creates or updates a non-conformance record using `itm_cd`, `defect_cd`, `qty`, `descr`, and optional `grn_no` [^r14][^r19][^r20].
* **ncr_close**: Write service (`POST /ll72/svc/ncr_close`) that closes an open non-conformance report [^r14][^r16].

## Messages

The screen validates entries against the following error messages:
* [[err-itm-0011|ERR-ITM-0011]]: Displayed when an item code entered in `ITEM CD` is missing, obsolete, or inactive in the central master [^r7][^r14].
* **ERR-NCR-0001**: Displayed during `ncr_save` when mandatory fields (`ITEM CD`, `DEFECT CD`, `QTY`) are missing, or when `QTY` is zero or negative [^r8][^r14]. The service definition for `ncr_get` also assigns ERR-NCR-0001 to indicate report not found [^r18].
* **ERR-NCR-0201**: Displayed when attempting to retrieve, modify, or close an `NCR NO` that does not exist in the database [^r10][^r14].
* **ERR-NCR-0801**: Displayed when attempting to modify or execute `ncr_save` or `ncr_close` against an already closed non-conformance report [^r9][^r14].

## Versions and conflicts

* **ERR-NCR-0001 error definition**: Screen user manuals define ERR-NCR-0001 as a validation failure on `ncr_save` when mandatory fields are omitted or quantity is non-positive (MAN-PRD-72, MAN-SCR-72) [^r8][^r14]. However, the backend definition for `ncr_get` defines ERR-NCR-0001 as "NON-CONFORMANCE REPORT NOT FOUND" (`ncr_get.yaml`) [^r18]. (kind: `contradiction`).
* **ncr_no field requirement**: Screen references designate `ncr_no` as a mandatory field on QA-NCR-02 (MAN-PRD-72, MAN-SCR-72) [^r6][^r13], whereas the `ncr_save` service schema lists only `itm_cd`, `defect_cd`, `qty`, and `descr` as required input parameters (`ncr_save.yaml`) [^r20]. (kind: `contradiction`).

r1.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r1.quote: Once the pack is physically secured in the cell, the team leader raises the non-conformance report on screen QA-NCR-02 before the shift ends. The batch number stamped on the casing is entered into the system so Stores can freeze the remaining units from the same intake pallet pending inspection by Quality.

r2.quote: Raise an NCR on QA-NCR-02 for every rejected lot.

r3.loc_text: p. 4, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r3.quote: When generating an NCR on QA-NCR-02, verify that the delivery reference, part identification, and the precise failure reasons populate accurately from the inspection sheet before submitting.

r4.loc_text: p. 4, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r4.quote: If the serial number on the pack is defaced or unreadable, enter the batch reference on QA-NCR-02, note the illegible marking in the narrative box, and request an immediate physical check by the quality team.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: Screen QA-NCR-02, menu Production > Non-Conformance report. Services: ncr_save, ncr_get, ncr_search, ncr_close.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: Screen QA-NCR-02, menu Production > Non-Conformance report. Services: ncr_save, ncr_get, ncr_search, ncr_close.

r7.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r7.quote: ERR-ITM-0011: This message appears when the value entered in the ITEM CD field cannot be found in the system parts master, or if the part has been flagged as obsolete or inactive.

r8.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r8.quote: ERR-NCR-0001: This message indicates that required header information is missing or incomplete at the point of saving.

r9.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r9.quote: ERR-NCR-0801: This message appears when you attempt to execute service ncr_save or service ncr_close against a report that has already been closed.

r10.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r10.quote: ERR-NCR-0201: This message is displayed when you attempt to retrieve, modify, or close a record using an entry in the NCR NO field that does not exist in the database.

r11.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r11.quote: If a single pallet contains several different defective part references, you must save an individual report for each separate item reference.

r12.quote: Menu: Production > Non-Conformance report. Roles: [PRD-PLAN, PRD-SUP, QA-INSP, QA-MGR, SYS-ADMIN].

r13.quote: ITEM CD itm_cd str Yes DEFECT CD defect_cd str Yes QTY qty int Yes DESCRIPTION descr str Yes NCR NO ncr_no str Yes

r14.quote: Save F8 ncr_save Get F3 ncr_get Search F2/Enter ncr_search Close ncr_close

r15.quote: Kind: write. Screen: QA-NCR-02. Since: 7.0. Procedures: sp_ncr_save.

r16.quote:
service: ncr_close
title: NON-CONFORMANCE REPORT CLOSE
module: PRD
kind: write
screen: QA-NCR-02

r17.quote:
service: ncr_get
title: NON-CONFORMANCE REPORT GET
module: PRD
kind: read
screen: QA-NCR-02

r18.quote:
errors:
  - {code: ERR-NCR-0001, msg: NON-CONFORMANCE REPORT NOT FOUND}

r19.quote:
service: ncr_save
title: NON-CONFORMANCE REPORT SAVE
module: PRD
kind: write
screen: QA-NCR-02

r21.quote:
service: ncr_search
title: NON-CONFORMANCE REPORT LIST
module: PRD
kind: read
screen: QA-NCR-02

r22.quote: NCR on QA-NCR-02 in the same shift Never put a dropped pack back on the shelf

r23.loc_text: p. 3, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r23.quote: The report on QA-NCR-02 must be completed during the very shift in which the fault was found. Staff frequently attach vague descriptions without uploading photographic evidence of the physical damage, the serial plate, and the terminal condition.

r24.loc_text: p. 4, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r24.quote: On QA-NCR-02, verify that the serial number typed into the header matches the serial label on the quarantined casing exactly, without transposed characters. Check that the defect classification chosen on QA-NCR-02 accurately describes the physical damage, whether it involves casing rupture, terminal shorting, or swelling.

conflicts.other: ncr_no is not required to save an initial report via service ncr_save
